t: ff.22 Do we eat too much?
st: Circadian rhythms, kilocalories and mice that don't gain weight

sec.p: I recently read a great book called The Circadian Code, about how important our circadian biological rhythm is for psycho-physical well-being.

sec.t: ff.22.2 Set another place (and a few kcal) at the table
sec.p: Another thing we care about is socialising. In company, we can end up eating 25% up to 50% more than what we would eat if we were alone.
